model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the training rewards for two different models, Llama-On-Policy and Llama-LUFFY, on both easy and hard training sets. The x-axis represents the number of steps, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 500, and tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis represents the training rewards, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 0.4 for the easy training set and 0 to 0.2 for the hard training set, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1 and 0.05, respectively. 

In the easy training set plot, Llama-On-Policy-Easy is represented by a blue solid line, starting at around 0 at 0 steps and increasing to approximately 0.2 at 200 steps before declining to around 0.1 at 500 steps. Llama-LUFFY-Easy is represented by a red solid line, beginning at around 0 at 0 steps and rising to about 0.2 at 150 steps, then gradually decreasing to roughly 0.1 at 500 steps. 

In the hard training set plot, Llama-On-Policy-Hard is depicted by a blue solid line, starting at around 0.05 at 0 steps and rapidly dropping to 0 at around 100 steps. Llama-LUFFY-Hard is represented by a red solid line, starting at approximately 0 at 0 steps, increasing to around 0.1 at 150 steps, and then fluctuating between 0.05 and 0.1 until 500 steps.
